summary: Solution Architect intake review passed for module `registration`. Source review and prior iteration-review evidence show the completed intake covers registration first/last name persistence, Google first-time consent gating, welcome email via Gmail configuration, authenticated dashboard shell with collapsible menu/user/logout/theme controls, feedback request Excel upload with batch/feedback persistence and email links, and public feedback submission with 30-day expiry and read-only repeat visits. Fresh checks run in this review passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`; `npx.cmd prisma validate`; `npx.cmd prisma migrate status` reported 5 migrations and `Database schema is up to date!`; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; `npm.cmd run lint`; and the full unit source suite passed with 28/28 tests. Prior production-verification evidence records a successful `npm.cmd run build`; I did not rerun build in this read-only review. Browser verification, Playwright/e2e tests, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real email/customer contact were not run per task constraints and are not claimed as passed.
